items.title: Brand's barrister refers himself to regulator after report he confronted journalist
items.summary: Ian Winter allegedly confronted a reporter outside court who had investigated the comedian.

items.title: How 2000s lad culture helped Russell Brand to hide in plain sight
items.summary: The behaviour that formed the backdrop to Brand's prosecution also helped elevate him, writes the BBC's media editor Katie Razzall.

items.title: Trump replaces White House chief of staff days after Republicans suffer midterm defeats
items.summary: Miller, considered the architect of Trump's hard-line immigration policy, will move into the role on Monday.

items.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
items.summary: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.

items.title: Harry and five others seek to challenge Mail publisher privacy ruling
items.summary: The Duke of Sussex and other public figures lost a High Court case against the publisher of the Daily Mail and Mail on Sunday.

items.title: Watch: Is it the end of the road for Tesla's Cybertruck?
items.summary: The car company's CEO Elon Musk has said production will halt in Texas, to focus on the firm's self-driving Cybercabs.

items.title: Manhunt after boy injured by sword, sparking Gloucester school lockdowns
items.summary: Two schools went into lockdown following the incident and one woman has been arrested.

items.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
items.summary: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.
